name: Name
QuizLimit-info: Time: timed quiz. Number: defined number of questions
QuizLimitMode-info: Fixed: defined below for every game. Custom: set at the beginning of the quiz
Images-info: Never: no images. Only when needed: show images when sound cannot ensure identification. Always: image for every question
Sounds-info: Never: no sounds. Only when needed: play sound when image cannot ensure identification. Always: sound for every question
ImagesTypes-info: Basic: clear zoomed image. Realistic: real photography, harder identification
SoundsTypes-info: Song: classic bird song. Alarm: alarm call. All: random song or alarm call (harder)
AnswerSetting-info: Direct: get the correction right after you answer, for every bird. End: get the correction at the end.
quizduration-input-info: The duration of the quiz, given in seconds.
quizduration-input-error: Duration must be between 30s and 1800s in Fixed mode.
numberofbirds-input-error: Number of birds must be a number between 3 and 100 in Fixed mode.
ModeName-info: Give your playmode a name to save it! (Only letters and numbers allowed)
ModeName-error: There is already a playmode with this name!
choose-quiz-number: Choose number of questions in quiz
LanguageSetting-info: Language to give answers. Does not change game language!
Rarity-info: 1: only most common birds. 5: include rarest birds.
Food-info: All birds with at least 10% of their food from this niche will be selected
TraductionMode-info: Enable to be given the name of the bird in a chosen language.
TraductionMode-error: Must enable traduction mode if both images and sound are set to Never!
HintLanguage-info: The name of the bird will be given in this language.
HintLanguage-error: Hint Language cannot be the same as answering language!
HabitatHint-info: Enable to be allowed to know the habitats the species can live in
FoodHint-info: Enable to be allowed to know the trophic niches the species are in
CreateGameMode: Create a new Game Mode or edit exitsing ones
gamemode-name-exists: A Game Mode with this name already exists. Do you want to overwrite it?
gamemode-content-exists: A Game Mode with the same settings already exists. Do you want to rename it?
gamemode-notsaved: This Game Mode is not saved. Do you want to save it before exiting?
gamemode-notvalid: This Game Mode is not valid and will not be saved if you exit. Stay and continue editing?
did-not-have-time: You did not have time to choose an answer...
delete-gamemoded-confirmation: Do you want to delete this Game Mode?
